title: MV (FIXED) Yanfly Quest Journal Plugin Issue

posts.author: Solarae
posts.body:
I was using the Yanfly Quest Journal plugin in RPG Maker MV and everything was working normally at first. The quest menu showed up, and the system was functioning.
Then I tried to edit the quest objectives directly inside the plugin parameters to add multiple visible objectives.
I entered something like this:
"\c[4]10 Large Stones\c[0] found by a man in Meranlona's PUB.",
"\c[4]10 Large Pieces of Wood\c[0] found at Mahavale by a man at the INN.",
"\c[4]Find Bread\c[0] at any grocery store."
After saving and testing the game, the first error appeared saying there was a problem at position 2.
I tried adjusting the format, but after changing it again I got a new error saying there was a problem at position 0.
After this, the quest system completely stopped working and the Quest Journal menu option disappeared entirely from the in-game menu.
At this point:
The Quest Journal menu no longer appears at all
The game shows parsing errors related to the plugin data (position 2 and position 0 depending on the attempt)
Reverting the text does not immediately restore the menu unless the plugin settings are properly reset or restored to default
I am completely new to all of this, so I am looking for help. Once I understand the basic formatting issues, I believe that will be enough for me to continue on my own. I watched the video introducing this plugin, but I still didn’t fully understand it.
I also made sure the plugins are in the correct order in the plugin list. The instructions say to report it if there is a bug, and I followed everything correctly at first. Everything worked fine until I changed the quest objectives from the default setup.
After that, the quest system stopped working and the Quest Journal menu disappeared entirely, depending on the changes I made to the objectives.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Just at a glance make sure you actually start a new game after making plugin changes. Changes made to parameters of a plugin do not work with a save game. Same goes for the plugin order. (By the way also make sure your yanfly plugins are in the exact correct order as outlined here to avoid bugs. I know you said you have the correct order, but you didn't share a screenshot of your plugin manager, so I'm noting it again:
https://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/Category:Yanfly_Engine_Plugins
)
P.S. You might also wanna share a screenshot of your actual plugin parameters, more importantly the ones you're trying to edit so we can see what's actually being put in there.

posts.author: Solarae
posts.body:
I fixed the quest issue by correcting how the quest data was formatted for the plugin. The problem was that the description, objectives, and rewards were not structured in a way the Quest Journal plugin could properly read, so the quest wasn’t displaying or updating correctly in-game.
I reorganized everything properly, finally.
Example I used (multiple objectives):
​
Description:
["\"Kamma has requested materials to begin rebuilding the Goblin Village. Help gather the necessary supplies to restore what was lost.\""]
Objectives:
[
"\"\\\\c[4]10 Large Pieces of Wood\\\\c[0] from a man at the INN in Mahavale.\",
\"\\\\c[4]10 Large Stones\\\\c[0] from a man at the PUB in Meranlona.\"
,
\"\\\\c[4]10 Pieces of Bread\\\\c[0] from any grocery store.\""
]
Rewards:
["\"\\\\i[314]50000 Gold\""]
Example (single objective version):
​
Description:
["\"A villager has requested help clearing out nearby goblins.\""]
Objectives:
["\"\\\\c[4]Defeat 10 Goblin Mages\\\\c[0] in the forest.\""]
Rewards:
["\"\\\\i[314]1000 Gold\""]
Once I fixed the formatting to match what the plugin expects then everything started working properly. The quest showed up correctly, and the objectives displayed in-game without issues or crashes. The main problem came down to small mistakes, missing commas, misplaced brackets [ ], and incorrectly placed escape slashes \\, which were breaking it. It was a good learning experience having never really used this stuff before.
Also: title, quest type, difficulty, quest giver name, location acquired, didn't need to be formatted. I just typed it normally.
(I hope I explained all this right.)
